limitations: Counting destination includes delimiter scanning and excludes operating-system I/O.
JFR allocation stacks were collected separately; profiler scores are excluded.
The direct Writer control measures a different boundary from the process-stream fixtures.
JFR sampling weights are not per-operation allocation measurements; absence of a sampled stack alone is not a proof of zero allocation.
Fork variation is retained; these synchronous local fixtures do not qualify operating-system I/O, asynchronous load, or other backends.
